# Talli 3D Printing (تللي للطباعة ثلاثية الأبعاد)

> Custom 3D printing studio in the United Arab Emirates. We design and 3D print personalised items to order: name keychains, figures and characters, replacement parts, logos and signs, gifts and home décor. Customers send their idea online in a few taps and get a quote on WhatsApp. Delivery across the UAE or pickup. We speak Arabic and English.

## What we print
- Keychains and name tags: names, initials, school and shop logos.
- Figures and characters: toys, models, cake toppers.
- Replacement parts: broken clips, knobs and holders, printed new from a photo of the old part.
- Logos and signs: plaques, 3D letters, stands for shops, schools and events.
- Gifts and home décor: vases, holders and gifts for occasions (Eid, National Day, Flag Day, graduations, birthdays).
- Your own idea: tell us what you need and we design it and print it.

## Free tool for makers
- 3D printing price calculator (filament, print time, plates, part-full last plate, complexity, extras, markup, setup fee; any currency): https://talli3d.github.io/en/3d-printing-price-calculator (العربية: https://talli3d.github.io/3d-printing-price-calculator)

## How it works
1. Send your idea: pictures, size and colours on the order page (https://talli3d.github.io/order). There is also a quick AI order: describe the item in one sentence and we draw a picture of it.
2. Get your quote: we study it and reply on WhatsApp.
3. Approve on your phone: check each item and approve with one tap.
4. We print and deliver: printed in the UAE, delivered anywhere in the UAE or ready for pickup.

## Details
- Materials: PLA for fine detail, PETG for strength and heat.
- Colours: up to 4 colours in one print, no painting needed.
- Prices: a clear quote in AED before we start.
- Name: "Talli" (التلي) is the traditional Emirati braided embroidery, inscribed by UNESCO as Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2022. Like talli, every piece is built thread by thread, layer by layer.

## بالعربية
تللي للطباعة ثلاثية الأبعاد: طباعة حسب الطلب في الإمارات. ميداليات بالأسماء، مجسّمات وشخصيات، قطع بديلة، شعارات ولافتات، هدايا وديكور، بحتى 4 ألوان في القطعة الواحدة. أرسل فكرتك من صفحة الطلب واستلم عرض السعر عبر واتساب، والتوصيل لكل الإمارات أو الاستلام.
